subject: Suggested approach for the next classwork task
text:
Thank you for reviewing the first draft with me. The classwork prompt is clear enough, but the structure could still use a little more attention before the next review.

I think a helpful suggestion would be to separate the background notes from the evaluation. That should make the argument easier to follow and reduce the risk of repeating the same point too close together.

If you agree, we can start the next session by organizing the headings first, then filling in the gaps. That may save time and keep the work more focused. I kept this brief because the main issue is likely arrangement, not content. We can also check the word limit after each section.
